sentences.text: The night was quiet, but all the rooms stayed below 18.0 °C, which the WHO recommends avoiding in cold seasons.
The parents' room was the coldest, reaching 16.4 °C at 05:20.
The bathroom also felt chilly, dropping to 16.8 °C at 05:00.
Since many rooms were below 18.0 °C, perhaps checking the heating would be a kind idea.
